If a change of scenery and Giannis get him back to his past self, awesome. Either his fit with Giannis works better than expected and it's a steal--or he recoups some value and they have a positive 42m contract to trade. Or he continues on the path he's on and he can be used for contract matching on draft night with some valuable picks. Because if the Bucks don't do anything, they'll have Turner on 25m, Kuzma on 20m, Bobby on 14m, and AJ Green on 11m as their only tradeable contracts when they can access their 26 and 33 1sts to trade.
